options.content:
Physical cabling and Layer-1 checked against the golden P2P design (CVT v3).
The golden design calls for 1,524 switches — 1,008 NVLink, 184 InfiniBand, 332 Ethernet — carrying 21,177 links (16,128 IB + 5,048 Ethernet). The section below compares the as-built estate discovered by the switch-fw exporter against that design, plane by plane.
ClusterMinder / CVT: Open worklists · Inventory & coverage · Firmware & config alignment · Cable & Layer-1 vs golden

options.content:
#### Golden P2P design baseline (CVT v3)
| Plane | Links | Switches |
|---|---|---|
| **InfiniBand** (compute) | 16,128 | 184 (`S1..S184`) |
| **Ethernet** (FE + OOB) | 5,048 | 332 (Cumulus) |
| **NVLink** (NVL72) | — | 1,008 |
| **Total** | **21,177** | **1,524** |

Source of truth: `CVT_v3.xlsx` `Links` + `Nodes` sheets → `expected-topology.json`. Scale: 288 hosts/SU × 7 SU (8K) → 14 SU (16K).
